_communities_note: Fitch July 2022 cites 14 LPCs; by 2023 down to 12 (Casa de Manana transferred to Front Porch in Covia merger; Grand Lake Gardens divested). At 2019-12-31 snapshot, 14 communities likely.
_structural_note: HumanGood California Obligated Group (HGCOG) was formed in August 2019 concurrent with Series 2019 bond issuance — at snapshot 2019-12-31, the OG had just been established. Predecessor entities: American Baptist Homes of the West (ABHOW) + be.group (Southern California Presbyterian Homes), merged 2017 to form HumanGood; CA OG combines HumanGood NorCal + HumanGood SoCal + HumanGood Fresno.

fitch.source: Series 2019 bond issuance / Fitch initial assignment for new HGCOG structure

rating_actions_in_window.rationale_summary: Diverse 14-LPC platform with solid demand, adequate liquidity, consistent operations. Solid financial profile and proactive cost containment provide cushion to absorb COVID disruption.
Held investment-grade through COVID stress year
Diverse 14-LPC platform reduces overall operating risk and manages occupancy variations and pandemic pressures on sales/marketing/external admissions

material_events_in_window.event: Provider Relief Fund (PRF) recognition of $2.378M for HumanGood + $67K WA state DSHS funding — material COVID financial assistance
COVID-era IL occupancy dipped to ~85.3% systemwide (recovered to 87.3% by 2022, 93%+ by 2024). 2019 baseline likely 90%+.

verified_outcome._notes: 3 consecutive Fitch A- affirmations through pandemic. No downgrade. No outlook revision. No covenant breach disclosed. Strong COVID survival.
